metric_definition.clustering_increase: max over per-swap states of the adjacent-match fraction minus sum_t p_t^2; kept for comparison with the original figures, not null-corrected
metric_definition.excess_max: max adjacent-match fraction minus the mean of the same max over label permutations of the same value trajectory
metric_definition.excess_mean: time-averaged adjacent-match fraction minus its label-permutation mean
metric_definition.perm_p_max: per-trial permutation p-value of the max statistic
metric_definition.temporal_separation: absolute difference in per-algotype normalized mean swap index
